description:
Three defects in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/`: `fp_small_panel_gemm` reduces its u32 accumulators only after the full $k$ axis, so they overflow for $k > 2^{32} / (p-1)^2$, and no public documentation or check states the bound; the panel kernels in `fp_small_ple.rs` and `fp_medium_ple.rs` panic on a slice index when `win - 1 > PANEL_SCRATCH_COLS`, and their documentation lists no panic; `pack_i32x8_to_u8_local` in `fp_small_panel.rs` duplicates `fp_small_f32::pack_i32x8_to_u8`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `fp_small_panel_gemm` rejects or correctly handles every $k$ beyond its accumulator bound, covered by a test at the boundary, and its documentation states the supported domain.
- [hard] REQ-02: The panel kernels' window limit is a documented precondition checked at the safe boundary, or the kernels handle wider windows; the behavior is covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-03: One pack helper serves both kernels, per `@/inv/convention-convergence`.
title: Undocumented limits and a duplicated helper in the small-prime panel kernels
